summary: Provision new KMS/HSM-backed signing key + IAM policy for Offline Bundle Signing service (Redwood Private air-gapped bundles)
content:
Issue Summary
We need a new dedicated KMS/HSM-backed signing key and a least-privilege access policy for the Offline Bundle Signing service used in the Redwood Private release pipeline. This key will sign detached signatures for the air-gapped “offline bundle” artifacts. Request includes approvals, audit trail requirements, and rotation expectations.

Background / Why now
Release Engineering is adding a signing stage to the Private offline bundle pipeline (see ENG-3913). The pipeline must sign bundles in CI using a hardware-protected key with strong audit logs. Security leadership has requested key custody, access controls, and break-glass constraints be documented and enforced before pilot customer distribution.

Requested Action
1) Create a new signing key in KMS with HSM-backed protection.
2) Create/attach an IAM policy allowing the “offline-bundle-signer” workload identity (CI signer job) to use the key for signing only.
3) Ensure audit logging is enabled and exportable for compliance evidence.
4) Provide key metadata to Release Engineering (key id/arn + allowed principals + rotation plan + verification/public key export mechanism).

Key Requirements (Security/Compliance)
- Key type: asymmetric signing key (preferred: ECDSA P-256) in HSM-backed KMS.
- Usage: sign only (no decrypt, no data key generation). Verification must be possible offline by customers (public key distribution via bundle/installer docs).
- Scope: used only by release pipeline signing stage for offline bundles (no ad-hoc usage by engineers).
- Audit trail: Cloud audit logs must capture every Sign operation with principal, pipeline job identity, build id, and timestamp. Logs must be retained per standard security logging retention (per Naomi/Olga guidance).
- Access controls:
  - Only CI signer identity can call Sign.
  - Human access is break-glass only; no standing engineer permissions.
  - Allow Security Ops (Fiona McCarthy) read-only access to key metadata and audit logs for incident response.
- Rotation: support periodic rotation (target cadence: annual) without breaking verification of previously shipped bundles (old public keys must remain available for verification).

Environment / Scope
- Applies to: release pipeline signing stage for Redwood Private offline bundles.
- Environments: staging + prod release pipelines.
- Region: us-east (primary) + eu-west (secondary) if required for EU-only builds (confirm with Neha).

Proposed Policy (draft)
- Principal allowed to Sign: “ci/offline-bundle-signer” workload identity (OIDC-based) restricted by:
  - repository: redwood
  - workflow: release-offline-bundle-sign
  - environment: prod-release
  - branch/tag constraints: only signed release tags matching v*.*.*
- Deny all other actions including GetPrivateKey / ExportPrivateKey (if applicable) and any decrypt operations.
- Allow GetPublicKey (or equivalent) to a limited set of internal principals for publishing/verifier packaging.

Approvals Required
- Security Engineering: Marcus Lin (design/policy review)
- Security & Compliance: Naomi Feldman / Olga Petrov (evidence + retention)
- Exec sponsor: Dr. Aisha Rahman (key custody + break-glass posture)
- Infra/KMS ops: Neha Kapoor (operational readiness + on-call ownership)

Acceptance Criteria
- New key created and labeled clearly (owner team, purpose, rotation cadence).
- IAM policy applied and validated via a test signing run in staging.
- Audit logging verified: a test Sign operation produces a searchable audit event including the CI principal.
- Documented runbook snippet posted back to this ticket:
  - key id/arn
  - who can sign
  - how to rotate
  - how to retrieve public key for verifier packaging
  - how to respond to suspected compromise

Comments / Timeline
2025-03-04 (Connor O’Brien, Reporter)
- Requesting key provisioning ASAP; blocking merge/rollout of signing stage. We can test against staging immediately.

2025-03-05 (Hanae Suzuki, Assignee)
- Acknowledged. Creating new asymmetric signing key in KMS with HSM backing. Will propose policy tied to GitHub Actions OIDC subject claims for the signer workflow. Need confirmation on whether we require a second key for staging vs prod or separate aliases.

2025-03-05 (Marcus Lin)
- +1 to separate keys for staging vs prod (distinct blast radius and audit boundaries). Ensure no broad “kms:*” grants. Prefer explicit kms:Sign, kms:GetPublicKey only. Also ensure the workflow constraints are enforced (repo + environment + tag pattern).

2025-03-06 (Neha Kapoor)
- Infra preference: separate keys with aliases:
  - alias/offline-bundle-signing-prod
  - alias/offline-bundle-signing-staging
  Ownership: Security Engineering (policy) + Infra (operational). On-call: Infra primary, SecEng secondary.

2025-03-06 (Olga Petrov)
- For evidence: we need a screenshot/export of key policy + a sample audit log record showing signer principal + timestamp. Retention is handled by central logging, but please confirm log group / dataset name and query.

2025-03-07 (Fiona McCarthy)
- Add SecOps read-only access to key metadata and audit logs. No ability to Sign. We will need an incident procedure for suspected compromise (disable key, revoke policy, publish revocation notice internally, and coordinate re-sign for new releases).

2025-03-07 (Dr. Aisha Rahman)
- Approved with conditions:
  - no standing human Sign permissions
  - break-glass access must be time-bound with VP approval and ticketed
  - rotation plan must preserve verification of existing bundles

Implementation Notes (Hanae)
- Created keys:
  - Prod: alias/offline-bundle-signing-prod (asymmetric signing, HSM-backed)
  - Staging: alias/offline-bundle-signing-staging (asymmetric signing, HSM-backed)
- Key policy:
  - CI signer identity allowed kms:Sign on the specific key only, with OIDC claim conditions restricting repo/workflow/environment/tag.
  - Release Engineering group granted kms:GetPublicKey for packaging the public key into verifier artifacts and docs.
  - SecOps granted read-only metadata access.
  - Explicit denies for non-required actions.
- Audit logging:
  - Verified kms:Sign events appear in central audit dataset; added query example to internal notes and attached to ticket.

Resolution
Completed key creation and access policy. Staging signing run completed successfully; audit event confirmed. Provided key aliases + public key export procedure to Connor/Sahana for pipeline integration.

Follow-ups
- ENG-3919: finalize rotation + revocation procedure and ensure installer can validate against multiple allowed public keys (current + previous).
- Documentation: add customer-facing verification instructions and publish public key fingerprint(s) in the install guide (tracked in ENG-3918).

Attachments / Evidence
- Key policy export: attached (internal)
- Audit log sample: attached (internal)
- Approval references: noted above (Aisha/Marcus/Neha/Olga/Fiona)
